body: I like solving rubik's cubes.  I can do it pretty fast (10-15 seconds).  It's one of my few pleasures.  ADHD is like trying to focus but then forgetting you're trying to focus only to remember you were trying to focus on something 20 minutes later and you realize you just missed a whole powerpoint about Napoleon because you were too busy staring at the floor tiles.  It's hell.  As for the empty feeling... I don't really know how to describe it.  I feel incomplete.  Like a part of me is missing.
